title: Will your kids be in Sunday School today? Do you work with kids and youth?
excerpt: If so, I hope you’ll consider being part of an important gathering in May 2012 in Washington, DC. I’ll be there, and I hope you will too. You’ll find information and a provocative article at the site of the gathering’s organizer, author Dave Csinos.
